# DATA
## I download the data

```{r}
# Creating file path to dowload the data
folder <- "data"
dir.create(folder, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

file_toilets <- file.path(folder, "toilets_amsterdam.geojson")
file_districts_with_water <- file.path(folder, "districts_with_water_amsterdam.geojson")
file_districts <- file.path(folder, "districts_amsterdam.geojson")
file_airbnb <- file.path(folder, "airbnb_amsterdam_listings.csv")
file_hotels <- file.path(folder, "tourism_amsterdam.geojson")
file_licences <- file.path(folder, "horeca_licences.geojson")
```

```{r}
# Parameters
crs_metric <- 28992
taille_page <- 5000
options(timeout = 180)
```

Les éléments pour le rendu

2.1 DEFINING BOUNDARIES : La ville d'Amsterdam (qui est particulière avec les canaux et la discontinuité) + Des quartiers (aller voir comment ils sont découpés)
2.3 CHLOROPLETH MAP : Idéal pour voir une variable quantitative
3.2 GEOCODING : Ici les codes de positions sont très bien renseignés (format point) donc pas besoin de modifier quelque chose
3.3 SYMBOLOGY BASED ON ATTRIBUTES : La carte des toilettes selon qu'ils soient ouverts ou non
3.3 HEAT MAPS : Pour les airbnb on utilise cette carte
3.4 SPATIAL JOIN : Pas besoin de cette partie
3.5 EXPORT MAPS : Pas nécessaire non plus
4.2 CONSTRUCTING GEOMETRY : Pas nécessaire non plus

A CELUI/CELLE QUI DECRIRA LES DONNEES : Pour airbnb elles viennent de ce site internet https://insideairbnb.com/fr/
Les autres viennent de openstreetmap pour les toilettes et quartiers

Pour les données des hôtels elles viennent de ce site (il faut faire une requête overpass) : https://overpass-turbo.eu/

Pour les cafés, bar et restaurants : https://api.data.amsterdam.nl/v1/wfs/horeca/

```{r}
# Pasting the urls to download the data
url_airbnb <- paste0(
  "https://data.insideairbnb.com/the-netherlands/north-holland/amsterdam/",
  "2026-09-16/visualisations/listings.csv")

url_toilets <- paste0(
    "https://maps.amsterdam.nl/open_geodata/geojson_lnglat.php",
    "?KAARTLAAG=OPENBARE_TOILETTEN&THEMA=openbare_toiletten")

url_districts <- paste0(
    "https://maps.amsterdam.nl/open_geodata/geojson_lnglat.php",
    "?KAARTLAAG=INDELING_WIJK_EXWATER&THEMA=gebiedsindeling")

url_districts_with_water <- paste0(
    "https://maps.amsterdam.nl/open_geodata/geojson_lnglat.php",
    "?KAARTLAAG=INDELING_WIJK&THEMA=gebiedsindeling")

# Function to construct url for licences
url_wfs <- function(couche, debut, nb) {
  paste0(
    "https://api.data.amsterdam.nl/v1/wfs/horeca/v1",
    "?SERVICE=WFS&VERSION=2.0.0&REQUEST=GetFeature",
    "&COUNT=", nb,
    "&STARTINDEX=", debut,
    "&TYPENAMES=app:", couche,
    "&OUTPUTFORMAT=application/json",
    "&SRSNAME=EPSG:4326"
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Set of functions to download the data based on url and path destination
download <- function(url, destination) {
  tryCatch(
    download.file(url, destfile = destination, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE),
    error = function(e) {
      stop("Échec du téléchargement : ", conditionMessage(e), call. = FALSE)
    }
  )
}

# Special function for licences
download_wfs <- function(couche, destination, nb = taille_page) {
  pages <- list()
  for (p in 1:20) {
    tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".geojson")
    download(url_wfs(couche, (p - 1) * nb, nb), tmp)
    page <- st_read(tmp, quiet = TRUE, int64_as_string = TRUE)
    st_crs(page) <- 4326
    unlink(tmp)
    if (nrow(page) == 0) break
    pages[[p]] <- page
    cat("Page", p, ":", nrow(page), "objets\n")
    if (nrow(page) < nb) break
  }
  resultat <- do.call(rbind, pages)
  st_write(resultat, destination, delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
}
```


```{r}
# Downloading
download(url_airbnb, file_airbnb)
download(url_toilets, file_toilets)
download(url_districts_with_water, file_districts_with_water)
download(url_districts, file_districts)
download_wfs("exploitatievergunning", file_licences)
```

```{r}
# Two functions to add water layer to the map
load_water <- function(districts, dossier = "data") {
  fichier <- file.path(dossier, "districts_with_water_amsterdam.geojson")

  complet <- st_read(fichier, quiet = TRUE)
  if (is.na(st_crs(complet))) st_crs(complet) <- 4326

  complet <- st_transform(st_make_valid(complet), st_crs(districts))
  districts <- st_make_valid(districts)

  eau <- st_difference(
    st_union(st_geometry(complet)),
    st_union(st_geometry(districts))
  )

  st_sf(geometry = eau)
}

add_water <- function(water) {
  geom_sf(data = water, fill = "#bcd7ea", color = NA)
}
```

## I get them in the environment

```{r}
# Datasets in the environment
districts <- st_read(file_districts, quiet = TRUE)
toilets <- st_read(file_toilets, quiet = TRUE)
airbnb <- read.csv(file_airbnb, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
hotels <- st_read(file_hotels, quiet = TRUE)
licences <- st_read(file_licences, quiet = TRUE)
```

## Data processing

```{r}
## Two Functions to create new variables
# This function matches the point (toilet, hotel...) with the district it is in
match <- function(points, zones) {
  idx <- st_within(points, zones)
  vapply(idx, function(i) if (length(i) > 0) i[1] else NA_integer_, integer(1))
}

# This functions aggregates the nb of points per district
count_point <- function(district_id) {
  tabulate(district_id[!is.na(district_id)], nbins = nrow(districts))
}
```


```{r}
# A little bit of data processing
# DISTRICTS
districts <- st_transform(districts, crs_metric) %>%
  dplyr::select(Wijk, geometry)
districts$surface_km2 <- as.numeric(st_area(districts)) / 1e6
districts$district_id <- seq_len(nrow(districts))

water <- load_water(districts)

# TOILETS
coords <- st_coordinates(toilets)
toilets <- toilets[which(coords[, "X"] != 0 & coords[, "Y"] != 0), ]
toilets <- st_transform(toilets, crs_metric) %>%
  dplyr::select(Openingstijden, geometry)
toilets$district_id <- match(toilets, districts)
toilets$open_24h <- grepl("\\b24\\b", toilets$Openingstijden, perl = TRUE) # Toilets 24/7 availability

# HOTELS
hotels <- st_transform(hotels, crs_metric) %>%
  dplyr::select(id, name, geometry)
hotels$district_id <- match(hotels, districts)

# AIRBNB
airbnb <- st_as_sf(airbnb, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)
airbnb <- st_transform(airbnb, crs_metric) %>%
  dplyr::select(id, room_type, geometry)
airbnb$district_id <- match(airbnb, districts)

# LICENCES
licences <- licences %>%
  st_transform(crs_metric) %>%
  filter(!is.na(st_is_empty(geometry)), !st_is_empty(geometry)) %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  st_point_on_surface() %>%
  dplyr::select(id, zaak_categorie, geometry)

# Filter some categories : for example night clubs
categories_to_drop <- c("Zalenverhuur", "Eethuis", "Hotel", "Nachtzaak", "Onbekend")
licences <- licences %>%
  filter(!zaak_categorie %in% categories_to_drop)

licences$district_id <- match(licences, districts)

# 2 classes typology
licences <- licences %>%
  mutate(
    classe = case_when(
      zaak_categorie %in% c(
        "Restaurant", "Fastfood", "Mengformule", "Restaurant met zaalverhuur"
      ) ~ "restaurant_snack",
      zaak_categorie %in% c(
        "Café", "Alcoholvrij", "Coffeeshop", "Café met zaalverhuur",
        "Sociëteit", "Culturele horeca", "Additionele horeca"
      ) ~ "cafe_bar",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_))
```

## New variables

```{r}
# --- Districts overview ------------------------------------
districts$n_hotels    <- count_point(hotels$district_id)
districts$n_airbnb    <- count_point(airbnb$district_id)
districts$n_toilets <- count_point(toilets$district_id)
districts$n_horeca <- count_point(licences$district_id)
districts$n_restaurant_snack <- count_point(licences$district_id[licences$classe == "restaurant_snack"])
districts$n_cafe_bar <- count_point(licences$district_id[licences$classe == "cafe_bar"])

districts$hotels_km2    <- districts$n_hotels    / districts$surface_km2
districts$airbnb_km2    <- districts$n_airbnb    / districts$surface_km2
districts$toilets_km2 <- districts$n_toilets / districts$surface_km2
districts$horeca_km2 <- districts$n_horeca / districts$surface_km2
districts$restaurant_km2 <- districts$n_restaurant_snack / districts$surface_km2
districts$cafe_bar_km2 <- districts$n_cafe_bar / districts$surface_km2
```

# MAPS

```{r}
# Square root transformation for better visualization
echelle <- function(nom) {
  args <- list(name = nom, option = "magma", direction = -1, na.value = "grey90")
  if (packageVersion("ggplot2") >= "3.5.0") args$transform <- "sqrt" else args$trans <- "sqrt"
  do.call(scale_fill_viridis_c, args)
}
```


```{r}
# Toilets
ggplot() +
  add_water(water) +
  geom_sf(data = districts, fill = "grey95", color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_sf(data = toilets, aes(color = open_24h), size = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "#d95f02", "FALSE" = "#1b9e77"),
    labels = c("TRUE" = "24/7", "FALSE" = "Limited access"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  labs(title = "Public Toilets – Amsterdam") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Extract coordinates from the sf object
coords_bnb <- st_coordinates(airbnb)

# Calculate KDE based on coordinates
kde_bnb <- kde2d(coords_bnb[, 1], coords_bnb[, 2], n = 500) # n specifies the number of grids

# Convert KDE to raster format
kde_bnb_df <- expand.grid(x = kde_bnb$x, y = kde_bnb$y)
kde_bnb_df$z <- as.vector(kde_bnb$z)

# Create neighborhood centroids : The same for all the maps
amsterdam_centroids <- st_centroid(districts)
```

```{r}
# Maps for AirBnB Visualization
map1_bnb <- ggplot() +
  add_water(water) +
  geom_sf(data = districts,
          fill = "lightgray",
          size = 0.02,
          color = "white"
          ) +
  geom_sf(data = airbnb, 
          color = "red",    
          size = 0.4,       
          alpha = 0.4
          ) + 
  theme_void()

map2_bnb <- ggplot() +
  geom_raster(data = kde_bnb_df, 
              aes(x = x, y = y, fill = z), 
              alpha = 1) +  # Kernel density heat map
  geom_sf(data = districts, fill = NA, color = "black") +
  add_water(water) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = c("transparent", "lightpink", "red", "darkred"), name = "Density") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

map3_bnb <- ggplot() +
  add_water(water) +
  geom_sf(data = districts, aes(fill = airbnb_km2), color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  echelle("Annonces / km²") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

map4_bnb <- ggplot() +
  add_water(water) +
  geom_sf(data = districts,
          fill = "lightgray",
          linewidth = 0.2,
          color = "white") +
  geom_sf(data = amsterdam_centroids,
          aes(size = n_airbnb),
          color = "red",
          alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 5) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

combined_bnb <- ggpubr::ggarrange(map1_bnb, map2_bnb, map3_bnb, map4_bnb, nrow=2, ncol=2,
                  labels = c("Point Map", "Heat Map", "Choropleth Map", "PropSymbol Map"))

print(combined_bnb)
```

```{r}
# --- Relative ranking -------------------------------------
districts <- districts %>%
  mutate(
    rank_horeca = rank(-horeca_km2, ties.method = "min"),
    rank_hotels = rank(-hotels_km2, ties.method = "min"),
    rank_airbnb = rank(-airbnb_km2, ties.method = "min"),
    score = rank_horeca + rank_hotels + rank_airbnb
  )


centroids_toilets <- amsterdam_centroids %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_toilets > 0)

centroids_zero <- amsterdam_centroids %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_toilets == 0)
```

```{r}
carte_classement <- ggplot() +
  add_water(water) +
  geom_sf(
    data = districts,
    aes(fill = score),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = centroids_toilets,
    aes(size = n_toilets),
    shape = 21,
    fill = "white",
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = centroids_zero,
    shape = 4,
    size = 3,
    color = "red",
    stroke = 1.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "magma",
    direction = -1,
    name = "Ranking"
  ) +
  scale_size_area(
    max_size = 10,
    name = "Toilets"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Relative ranking of districts based on tourist facilities",
    subtitle = "Hotels, restaurants, cafes and airbnb",
    caption = "Red crosses are districts with no public toilet"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

print(carte_classement)
```
